content.problemStatement: Write a program for the coding challenge "Napoleon Cake". Refer to LeetCode description: https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1501/B
content.inputFormat: The first line contains an integer T, the number of test cases. Then T test cases follow. The first line of each test case contains an integer n, the number of layers in the cake. The second line contains n integers, the radius of each layer.
content.outputFormat: For each test case, print the maximum number of layers that can be cut.

solution.approach: Sort the layers by their radii in descending order. Then, iterate over the sorted layers and try to cut each layer. If the current layer can be cut, increment the count of cut layers.
solution.timeComplexity: O(n log n) due to sorting
